scripts.site: bun build.ts && bun install --cwd ../origami-site --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ../origami-site build && cp -R dist ../origami-site/out/docs && cp ../latest.json _redirects ../origami-site/out/
scripts.deploy: bun run site && wrangler r2 object put origami-downloads/Origami.dmg --file ../dist/Origami.dmg --content-type application/x-apple-diskimage --remote && wrangler deploy
